PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Safety.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

3. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Composite Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials.

7. When learning Dimensioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Dimensioning.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Dimensioning.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Dimensioning.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Dimensioning.

8. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.

9. When learning Cutting Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools.

10. When learning Visual Programming, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Visual Programming.

11. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

12. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Plane Geometry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dimensioning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Plain Scale Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Visual Programming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
